name: ai-context-vscode
displayName: AI Context Tools for VS Code
description: Language model tools for live notebook outputs + automatic VS Code version recording

languageModelTools.name: aicReadLiveCellOutput
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the output of a notebook cell directly from the live VS Code document model. Works even if the notebook has NOT been saved to disk, and has no output size limit. Use this tool INSTEAD of read_notebook_cell_output when that tool fails with 'output too large', or whenever you need unsaved cell outputs. Returns stdout, stderr, text/plain, and error outputs as text. Image outputs are noted but not returned.

cellNumber.description: 1-based cell number to read output from.

notebookUri.description: URI of the notebook (e.g. file:///path/to/notebook.ipynb). If omitted, uses the active notebook.

languageModelTools.name: aicListNotebookCells
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List all cells in a notebook with their type, execution count, source preview, and output summary. Reads from the live VS Code document model — no save required. Use this to discover which cells have outputs before reading them with aicReadLiveCellOutput.

notebookUri.description: URI of the notebook. If omitted, uses the active notebook.

languageModelTools.name: aicKernelEval
languageModelTools.displayName: Evaluate Expression in Live Notebook Kernel
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Evaluate a single Python expression against the live notebook kernel and return its repr. READ-ONLY BY CONVENTION: send only expressions you would type at a REPL (e.g. `run_sub.sv_history`, `len(my_list)`, `obj.attr`), not statements or assignments. Requires the Jupyter extension and a kernel that has already been started for the notebook (run any cell once). Returns `{ok: true, repr, status, truncated}` on success, `{ok: false, kernel_busy: true}` if the kernel is currently executing another cell (refuses to queue), or `{ok: false, ename, evalue}` on Python errors. Use this when you need to inspect live in-memory state (e.g. progress of a long-running optimization) without inserting and running a probe cell.

expression.description: A single Python expression to evaluate (not a statement). Will be wrapped as repr(...) and printed.

notebookUri.description: URI of the notebook (e.g. file:///path/to/notebook.ipynb). If omitted, uses the active notebook.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for the kernel to complete the evaluation. Default: 5000.

maxCharacters.description: Maximum characters of repr text to return. Default: 8192.

languageModelTools.name: aicRunCellAsync
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Start executing a notebook cell without blocking the chat. Unlike run_notebook_cell (which blocks until completion), this tool triggers the cell and returns immediately with {ok: true, started: true}. Use this for long-running cells (optimizations, training runs, etc.) so the conversation stays responsive. After calling this, use aicListNotebookCells to check when the execution count changes (cell finished), then aicReadLiveCellOutput to read the output.

notebookUri.description: URI of the notebook (e.g. file:///path/to/notebook.ipynb). If omitted, uses the active notebook.

languageModelTools.name: aicEditNotebookCell
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace the source of a notebook cell by writing directly into VS Code's live document model via WorkspaceEdit. Use this INSTEAD of edit_notebook_file when a notebook is open in the editor — edit_notebook_file writes to disk and is silently ignored while the notebook is open in memory. This tool applies the same edit path as a human typing in the cell. The notebook is marked dirty after the edit; the user saves with Ctrl+S. Returns {ok: true, cellNumber, language, message} on success.

newSource.description: The complete new source code (or markdown) for the cell. Replaces the entire existing content.

notebookUri.description: URI of the notebook (e.g. file:///path/to/notebook.ipynb). If omitted, uses the active notebook.
